elements.initial_presentation: 68-year-old male brought by EMS with sudden onset left-sided facial droop, left arm and leg weakness, and slurred speech starting 75 minutes ago. NIHSS score: 14. Vitals: BP 168/94 mmHg, HR 82 bpm regular, RR 16/min, SpO2 97%.
elements.patient_history: History of non-valvular atrial fibrillation, hypertension, previous TIA 2 years ago. Medications: Apixaban 5mg BID (reports taking this morning), Lisinopril 20mg. NKDA.
elements.investigation_attachments: Non-contrast Head CT: No intracranial hemorrhage; early ischemic signs in right MCA territory with ASPECTS score 9. CT Angiography: Occlusion of proximal right M1 segment of middle cerebral artery.

evidence: Caution/contraindication with IV thrombolysis due to recent DOAC
